about: Approximate site plan of Moshood Abiola National Stadium, Abuja, measured by eye from a Google Earth screenshot (200 m scale bar = 289 px) and checked against OSM. Reference only. Use OSM for exact geometry.
origin: stadium centre (OSM centroid about 9.0381 N, 7.4535 E)
axes: +x east, +z south, +y up. North is up in the drawing.
accuracy: high = matches OSM, medium = about +/-20 m, low = about +/-40 m or shape only

features.label: Paved apron
features.notes: Dark grey concrete ring around the stadium. Ticket booths and portacabins sit on it.

features.label: Stadium (roof outer edge)
features.notes: Matches the OSM bowl outline (about 238 x 288 m). Use the real OSM polygon for the final shape.

features.label: Roof opening
features.notes: About 0.55 of the outer scale. Steel ring truss with floodlights hangs on this edge.

features.label: Athletics track (outer edge)
features.notes: Terracotta track. Long axis about 16 degrees off north-south (top leans west), taken from the OSM pitch polygon.

features.label: Football pitch
features.notes: Same tilt as the track. Check the exact polygon in the OSM data.

features.label: Ticket booths and portacabins
features.notes: About 40 to 48 small white boxes and canopies evenly spaced on the outer apron, denser on the south front.

features.label: Turnstile canopies (south entrance)
features.notes: Four white flat canopies in front of the south facade, on the avenue axis.

features.label: South avenue and gate plaza
features.notes: Wide paved approach from the south, narrowing toward a bridge or underpass at the south highway. Main fan arrival route.

features.label: Terraced car park, west
features.notes: Terraces with tree rows between them. Use the OSM amenity=parking polygons for exact shapes.

features.label: Terraced car park, south-west
features.notes: Large terraced lot with tree rows.

features.label: Car park, east
features.notes: Long paved lot east of the apron, with tree rows along the terraces.

features.label: Round building (radial roof, open courtyard)
features.notes: OSM way 1046913215. Do not label it as a velodrome or expo pavilion until verified.

features.label: Roundabout garden (star paths)
features.notes: Circular road around a garden, with paths radiating. Flagpoles near the centre.

features.label: Helipad
features.notes: Round concrete pad on a path from the roundabout.

features.label: White tensile-roof arena (tall masts)
features.notes: Faceted white fabric roof with tall masts. Do not label its function until verified.

features.label: Training pitch and track
features.notes: Terracotta track around a grass pitch, north-north-east of the stadium.

features.label: Throwing and warm-up fields (sandy)
features.notes: Dry sandy and patchy grass fields.

features.label: Gymnastics building
features.notes: Labelled TIG Gymnastics Abuja on the map.

features.label: Building with blue roof (unlabelled)
features.notes: Check OSM tags before labelling.

features.label: Orange-roofed housing (doctors quarters)
features.notes: Row of low orange-roofed houses in the far north-east.

features.label: West ring highway
features.notes: Wide dual carriageway looping around the west. Use OSM highway ways for exact geometry.

features.label: South highway
features.notes: Main road passing south of the site. The south avenue meets it at a bridge or underpass.

features.label: East dual carriageway
features.notes: Runs north-north-west to south-south-east on the east side.
